title: NoxNetwork
description: Collection of Mods and ResourcePacks for the NoxNetwork Server.
body:
### About 
Collection of Mods and Resource Packs for the NoxNetwork Server. Includes Performance Mods, QOL, Animations, Maps, Shaders and few other helpful mods.

### Compatibility
You might get an in-game "made for a newer version of Minecraft" warning. You can freely ignore it if you're playing on a version the resource pack file is tagged with.

<details>
<summary>List of mods</summary>
  
### Performance:
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling)
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)
- [Immediately Fast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
- [More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling)

### Quality Of Life:
- [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)
- [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)
- [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip)
- [Inventory Sorting](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-sorting)
- [Locator Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/locator-heads)
- [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam)
- [Stendhal](https://modrinth.com/mod/stendhal)
- [Lightweight Inventory Sorting](https://modrinth.com/mod/lightweight-inventory-sorting)

### Miscellaneous:
- [[ETF] Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)
- [[EMF] Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)
- [Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations)
- [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons)

### Libraries:
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- [Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api)
  
</details>

<details>
  
<summary>Resoure Packs</summary>
  
### Animations:
- [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)
- [Fresh Animations: Extensions](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-extensions)
- [Fresh Animations: Player Extension](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fa-player-extension)

> Additionaly the [Just Expressions](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/just-expressions) resoure pack can be added for Animations of Player Character eye's _(Mod is outdated but it is working on MC 1.21.11)_

### Miscellaneous:

- [Armory Conglomery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/armory-conglomery)
- [Better Lanterns](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/better-lanterns)
- [(Bee's) Fancy Crops](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-crops)
- [Recolourful Containers GUI + HUD](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/recolourful-containers-gui)
- [Theone's Eating Animation Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/theones-eating-animation-pack)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Shaders</summary>

- [Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined)
- [Complementary Shaders - Unbound](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound)

</details>

_This is a Client-side only Modpack. No Server mods are required._

**_Hope you enjoy!_**
